annotation.authors_or_issuer: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA), UK
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes a National Commission to advise MHRA on a new regulatory framework for AI in healthcare, with recommendations due in 2026.
Seeks evidence on pre-market and post-market safety and performance of AI health technologies.
Asks how liability and responsibility are distributed across the AI supply chain.
Asks how to manage overlap between device regulation, professional oversight and service regulation.
Notes AI software with a medical purpose qualifies as a medical device under the Medical Devices Regulations 2002, with risk-class-based conformity assessment.
annotation.summary_en: MHRA call for evidence (18 Dec 2025 to 2 Feb 2026) supporting the National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare. It seeks views on the existing medical-device framework, pre- and post-market assurance, overlapping oversight, and liability across the AI supply chain, to inform a new regulatory framework.
